title: chart-decompose
intention: Stage 4 of the /chart chain: the DECOMPOSE brick. One narrow question: how does this request SPLIT? Not what is asked (orient), not what bounds it (constrain), not what exists (survey) — the pieces: SUB_PROBLEMS, each carrying its what, its why, and its KIND — 'compose' (uses holdings the survey berth carries, by address) or 'build' (fills an absence the survey measured, verbatim). Three strata: FLOOR — template-filled from the berthed survey packet (the chain deepens to depth 4: decompose -> survey -> constrain -> orient, re-checked whole by composing survey's own chain reader — one implementation, not a parallel walk), it hands the ceiling the intent, the bounds, and the exact compose/build VOCABULARIES the judges will enforce (holdings addresses, absence whats); TREE — the decompose brick's own corpus through the generalized verbs; CEILING — assembles the split with per-field provenance. Built UNDER the pre-installed judges (ticket decompose-filters): the berth door composes judge_decompose by identity; the module cannot shape its own acceptance.
why: Decompose is where a builder either derives the work from the chain or invents it. The dated failures are split-shaped: the 2026-07-24 done-while-unmoved substitution (a decomposition that dropped the expensive piece the chosen path implied and delivered a cheaper invented one) and stone 1's parallel roster (a piece built where a holding sat unreferenced). The kind field makes each piece's claim challengeable, and the floor's vocabularies make the honest split the path of least resistance: template-fill as physics — the ceiling receives exactly the words the judges will check. This is also /sail step 2 compiled one rung down the ladder: 'holdings are what you COMPOSE, absences are what you may BUILD' stops being skill prose and becomes the packet's schema.
traces_to: Law 1 — what the territory holds is composed by address, never re-derived; the tree remembers how this class of request split
Law 3 — every piece's kind is a measured claim against the berthed inventory
Law 4 — the schema gate + composed judges make an invented or parallel piece a build error, not a lapse
Law 8 — the brick's first berthed packet passes judges it did not write (decompose-filters, the live gate)

falsifier.proves_green: proof gate: test_chart_decompose.py (chain physics at depth 4 — refuses without a readable survey berth, and a broken link anywhere below refuses loudly; floor hands the judges' vocabularies verbatim from the berth; schema gate refuses hollow shapes; door composes judge_decompose BY IDENTITY; berth round-trips; deposit-back gated; import allowlist over import_map) under the tester's netns seal. Live gate: a real decompose packet for THIS ticket berths through judges the module did not write, deposits back, and registers on the dial.
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: stage 4 filling from the conversation instead of the berthed stage-3 file; the floor re-walking the chain in parallel instead of composing survey's reader; a compose outside the holdings or a build outside the measured absences passing the door; the door and the promotion gate disagreeing; the dial unable to read a decompose berth; the deposit-back seeding the tree with a packet whose berth is not on disk.
falsifier.horizon: re-read when triage lands (stage 5 template-fills from this berth); when a real split needs a third kind or explicit ordering (design events, filed at decompose-filters edges); when /moreabout signals show decompose fields recurrently too compressed.

questions.a: KNOWN-VS-NOVEL BECAME PHYSICS A STAGE EARLY: the kind field ties every piece to the survey berth's evidence — compose must cite a holding address, build must cite a measured absence verbatim. /sail step 2's prose discipline ('holdings composed, absences built minimal') moved down the ladder to schema in the same arc that proved the skill.

THE CHAIN PUSHES BACK UP: a piece that needs something the survey does not hold is refused — the honest cure is re-surveying (the holding gets measured in), not widening the split. Upstream completeness enforced from downstream.

COMPOSE-BY-IDENTITY AT THE CHAIN LEVEL: decompose's deep-link reader IS survey's _read_constrain_berth (identity-pinned in the proof) — the first stage-to-stage composition of chain-reading; each stage owns one new link, not a re-walk of all of them.

BUILT BY THE SKILL IT FEEDS: this stone was delivered inside the first real /sail crossing — /chart charted the decompose build, /sail sailed it, and the new stage extends the very chain /sail fills from. Dogfood in both directions, same day.

chart.why: THE `chart` DISSOLUTION, named by a hand because no rename record can name it (ticket a-bulk-move-forwards-itself-from-gits-own-rename-record, gate 3). The chart machine came apart on 2026-08-13: its 40 files went to skills/chart, seven builder machines under cairn/devices/builder/machines, cairn/tools/chain, cairn/tools/tree and skills/moreabout — no plurality, which is why the derivation correctly answers nothing and a hand must. skills/chart is the successor because the component's CHARTER moved there whole and now covers the skill AND the chain it calls: 'There is no separate device charter: the chart machine dissolved on 2026-08-13 and its charter moved here whole.'
